title: SpaceX业绩超预期 市场关注与特斯拉整合前景
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Meanwhile, we're keeping an eye on SpaceX. Those shares hop about 2% here on the back of its earnings revenue in the quarter coming in.
segments.zh: 与此同时，我们关注SpaceX。其股价在财报发布后上涨约2%，本季度营收表现亮眼。

segments.en: At about $15 billion on rounding up, the street was looking for about $13 billion, actual space revenue itself coming in at $1.77 billion.
segments.zh: 营收约150亿美元，高于市场预期的130亿美元，其中太空业务收入为17.7亿美元。

segments.en: That's a beat, connectivity revenue, $5.25 billion.
segments.zh: 超出预期，连接业务收入52.5亿美元。

segments.en: That's a beat, AI revenue, $7.6 billion.
segments.zh: 超出预期，AI业务收入76亿美元。

segments.en: That's also a beat, capex spending, $19.6 billion, pretty much with the street was looking for.
segments.zh: 同样超出预期，资本支出196亿美元，与市场预期基本一致。

segments.en: Ross Kerber joins us right now, co-founder, president and CEO of Kerber, Kawasaki, wealth and investment management, any own SpaceX, as well as Netflix.
segments.zh: Ross Kerber现在加入我们，他是Kerber, Kawasaki财富与资管业务的联合创始人、总裁兼CEO，持有SpaceX和Netflix。

segments.en: We'll get to Netflix in a second, Ross, but let's start with SpaceX here.
segments.zh: 我们稍后聊Netflix，Ross，但先从SpaceX开始。

segments.en: I mean, the numbers look, I guess, on the surface to be pretty good.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这些数字表面上看起来相当不错。

segments.en: I mean, how much does this actually tell us, though, about where SpaceX goes next?
segments.zh: 不过，这到底能在多大程度上告诉我们SpaceX下一步的走向？

segments.en: Well, I think it just confirms that it's a healthy business and it has a lot of good parts that are growing and profitable, especially the revenue number was pretty impressive.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为这恰恰证实了它是一项健康的业务，拥有许多增长且盈利良好的部分，尤其是营收数字相当亮眼。

segments.en: But I think SpaceX has moved its earnings report to in front of Tesla's for a reason, because this is the good news part of Elon's empire, and we'll see the bad news part tomorrow.
segments.zh: 但我认为SpaceX把财报提前到特斯拉之前发布是有原因的，因为这是马斯克帝国的好消息部分，而明天我们将看到坏消息部分。

segments.en: So SpaceX is doing well, and I wouldn't be surprised if they buy Tesla any day now.
segments.zh: 所以SpaceX表现不错，如果他们哪天收购特斯拉，我也不会感到意外。

segments.en: Yeah. Okay. Well, I mean, we talk about, well, how do they actually do that, Ross?
segments.zh: 是的。好吧，我的意思是，我们讨论过，他们究竟如何做到这一点，罗斯？
